title: Your First Weekend at Binghamton University, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Kick Off with Friday Bowling
cards.subtitle: University Union West
cards.notes: Start your weekend at the Undergrounds. Bowling is free for students; just bring 50 cents for shoe rentals. It's a central hub for meeting new people in a relaxed setting.
cards.short_summary: A student-focused recreation center featuring free bowling, billiards, and table tennis.
cards.evidence_claim: Bowling is free for currently enrolled undergraduate and graduate students with a 50 cent shoe rental fee.
cards.access_notes: Open Friday until 12:00 a.m. and Saturday from 2:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m.

cards.title: Join the Late Nite Crowd
cards.subtitle: University Union
cards.notes: Head to the Union on Friday or Saturday nights for free movies, casino nights, or carnivals. It is the primary weekend alternative to off-campus nightlife.
cards.short_summary: An award-winning weekend programming series offering free entertainment and prizes for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Late Nite Binghamton provides students with a variety of activities on Friday and Saturday evenings, including free movies and large-scale events.
cards.source_title: Late Nite | Campus Activities - Binghamton University
cards.access_notes: Events typically run Friday and Saturday nights from 8 p.m. to midnight.

cards.title: Saturday Morning Hike
cards.subtitle: Nature Preserve
cards.notes: Walk the Pond Trail to the iconic wooden bridge. It's a flat, easy path perfect for a quiet morning outdoors before the day's events pick up.
cards.short_summary: A 190-acre on-campus preserve featuring wetlands, a six-acre pond, and maintained hiking trails.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pond Trail starts behind College-in-the-Woods and leads to a famous bridge overlooking Harpur Pond.
cards.source_title: 5 Gorgeous Nature Preserve Trails You Must Hike This Fall - Binghamton News
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk; accessible from multiple campus parking lots.

cards.title: Lunch at the MarketPlace
cards.subtitle: University Union
cards.notes: Grab lunch at local favorites like Chick-N-Bap or Royal Indian. It's the social heart of campus dining and accepts meal plan dining dollars.
cards.short_summary: A central dining food court in the University Union featuring diverse retail food concepts.
cards.evidence_claim: The MarketPlace features regional favorites like Chick-N-Bap and is a hub for student dining.
cards.source_title: Dining Services | Auxiliary Services - Binghamton University
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by vendor; typically open for lunch and dinner on weekdays with limited weekend hours.

cards.title: Cheer at the Events Center
cards.subtitle: Bearcats Sports Complex
cards.notes: Join the boisterous student section for a Bearcats game. It's the largest sports facility in the region and the best place to show school spirit.
cards.short_summary: A 5,142-seat multi-purpose arena that serves as the home for Binghamton Bearcats basketball.
cards.evidence_claim: The Events Center includes a student section that seats more than 1,000 members of the BU community.
cards.source_title: Events Center - Facilities - Binghamton University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Accessible during scheduled athletic events and university ceremonies.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Library Tower
cards.notes: Explore the North or East Reading Rooms for quiet study. Finding your preferred corner early helps you stay ahead once classes begin on Monday.
cards.short_summary: The university's main library, housing collections in humanities, social sciences, and fine arts.
cards.evidence_claim: Designated quiet study spaces include the East Reading Room (1st floor) and North Reading Room (2nd floor).
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms and Study Spaces | Libraries - Binghamton University
cards.access_notes: Open daily during the academic year; check website for specific floor hours.

cards.title: Navigate via OCCT
cards.subtitle: Campus-Wide
cards.notes: Learn the bus routes by taking a loop on the student-run OCCT. It's free with your ID and connects the campus to downtown Binghamton and local shops.
cards.short_summary: A student-run transit service providing transportation around the university and local community.
cards.evidence_claim: OCCT provides transportation around the Binghamton University community at no cost with a scan of a valid student ID.
cards.source_title: Buses and Shuttles | Transportation and Parking Services - Binghamton University
cards.access_notes: Regular service runs daily; Late Nite shuttles operate Friday and Saturday nights.

cards.entity_name: Recreation Center at the East Gym
cards.title: Sunday Afternoon Open Rec
cards.subtitle: East Gym
cards.notes: Visit the East Gym for open recreation. You can play basketball, pickleball, or go for a swim just by signing in with your student ID.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus fitness and recreation facility offering gym courts, a pool, and fitness equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: All currently enrolled students have access to the Recreation Center at the East Gym for drop-in activities like basketball and swimming.
cards.access_notes: Open Saturday 9 a.m. - 8 p.m. and Sunday with regular academic year hours.

cards.entity_name: Anderson Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Catch a Show at Watters Theater
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts Building
cards.notes: Check the schedule for a student production or visiting artist. It's a great way to experience the campus arts scene before the semester gets busy.
cards.short_summary: A premier performing arts complex featuring the Osterhout Concert Theater and Watters Theater.
cards.evidence_claim: The Anderson Center features multiple performance spaces including the Osterhout Concert Theater and Watters Theater.
cards.source_title: Anderson Center for the Performing Arts - Binghamton University
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled performances and workshops; ticket prices vary by event.

cards.title: Photo with Baxter the Bearcat
cards.subtitle: University Union West
cards.notes: Find the statue of Baxter the Bearcat on the second floor of the Union. It's a classic spot for a first-weekend photo to commemorate your start at Bing.
cards.short_summary: A popular photo spot featuring a life-sized statue of the university mascot, Baxter.
cards.evidence_claim: Baxter's lookalike is located on the second floor of University Union West, right outside the Bookstore.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during University Union building hours.
